abstention.leakage_prevention_rule: Evaluation runner and product path must not receive ground truth query labels or branch on system_abstained flags during execution.

storage.policy_on_durable_spine_vs_derived_proje: The 3.00x storage multiplier ceiling strictly applies to the complete hot database capsule (durable SQLite WAL Spine events, raw atom chunks, source provenance, node/edge versions, FTS5 lexical indexes, and cortex graph state) active on disk at rest. Spine events must be immutable and durable; derived projections must be 100% rebuildable from Spine events with full parity. Raw upstream dataset downloads in ~/.cache and ephemeral staging files are excluded.

spine_vs_projections_policy.definition: The 3.00x storage multiplier ceiling strictly applies to the complete hot database capsule (durable SQLite WAL Spine events, raw atom chunks, source provenance, node/edge versions, FTS5 lexical indexes, and cortex graph state) active on disk at rest.
spine_vs_projections_policy.durable_spine_mandate: Spine event store and atom records must be immutable, durable, byte-exact, and sufficient for complete state reconstruction.
spine_vs_projections_policy.derived_projections_mandate: All projections (FTS5 lexical index, cortex graph tables, and version indices) are derived representations and must be rebuildable from Spine events with 100.0% parity.
excluded_offline_artifacts: raw dataset source downloads in ~/.cache or AppData

resilience.replay_scope: 100% full event replay from Spine events into a blank database capsule
